metric.derived_condition: For first-difference distance d(A,B)=w_delta, the natural sufficient condition for the strong triangle inequality and 'deeper agreement means closer' is w_{k+1}<=w_k. If w_k=prod_{j<k} r_j, this requires r_k<=1 for every metric scale.
metric.resolution: Allow geometric thickness/step to expand independently, but keep a separate similarity scale c_k in (0,1] for the metric.

injective_geometry_prototype.construction: Exact nested interval/address code using base 13 and a reserved separator symbol.
injective_geometry_prototype.interpretation: Finite ordered token paths can be embedded injectively into exact nested intervals; geometry can preserve full finite structure if its encoding is designed to be reconstructive.

descent_ascent.interpretation: Two traversals can start and end at the same structural locations yet remain different Omega histories because their event sequences differ.

identity_vs_geometry.interpretation: A purely structural geometry can encode the hierarchical number exactly, but Omega non-repetition requires an additional birth/history identity coordinate when two realizations share the same structure.
